title: If it could run itself tomorrow, what would you do?
intro: Be honest. This is the question that finds out whether you want the business or the working.
og_line: Five questions and what you would actually do with the time.

cta.title: Something a bit more serious
cta.label: The Energy Discovery
cta.blurb: That one was for fun. The Energy Discovery is 48 statements and returns how you actually work across all twelve energies.

questions.q: The last real break you took:

options.a: I spent it helping someone else
A while ago, and it was good

questions.q: If someone gave you a year, paid:

options.a: I would go and keep going
The first month would be a blur
I would find work that matters
I would stop and see what happens

questions.q: The reason you have not already:

options.a: It never feels like the right month
There is always one more thing
I would not know who I was

results.name: Travel
results.headline: You have been saving it up.
results.body: There is a list and it is long and it has not moved in years. You have been treating rest as something you earn afterwards.
results.cost: Afterwards keeps moving. It has moved twice since you started.

results.name: Start another one
results.headline: It was never about this business.
results.body: You like the beginning. The bit where it is a blank page and anything is still possible.
results.cost: Beginnings are the only bit you are practised at, which is why nothing gets to year five.

results.name: Sleep
results.headline: That is not a joke answer.
results.body: You are running a deficit and you know it. The honest answer to what you want is not ambitious, it is horizontal.
results.cost: Tired is not a personality and it is not a strategy either.

results.name: Give the time away
results.headline: The business was always the means.
results.body: You want the freedom to be useful somewhere that does not pay, which is a good reason to have built the thing.
results.cost: You put this off exactly as long as you put off rest.

results.name: Nothing, for six months
results.headline: And you would not feel guilty.
results.body: You have earned the right to stop and you know that you would take it. That is rarer and healthier than it sounds.
results.cost: Six months of nothing is where people find out what they actually miss.
